rules.gap: The engine has no openings with heights, so it cannot work out the angle at which an opening immerses (IS Code Part A 2.2.1; the meaning of the angle is in Part B 2.2.3.5). Type it as the input downflooding_angle_deg. With none typed the areas run to 40 degrees, so a design may pass 2.2.1 where it fails with the angle
